title: Cod with mango salsa
summary: Cod with mango salsa is a mexican dinner built around cod fillets and mango, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat cod fillets dry and season it. Prep mango and red onions for Cod with mango salsa so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook cod fillets on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook mango and red onions in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Cod with mango salsa before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice cod fillets and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
